youtube.title: Good Morning Bible Verse | Nehemiah 8:10 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Feeling weak already? This is for you.

"Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our LORD: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength." Nehemiah 8:10 (KJV)

Your strength today doesn't come from coffee. It comes from his joy.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
